svg.text: Port CallerVerifier: runs on every DSP route
and hands the verified DID to the handler
HTTP adapters for both roles: parse, call the
negotiations and transfers as consumer, with
their data addresses; transfers as provider;
HTTP pull: checks the data token and the
dataset's source (an HTTP URL, or s3://
catalog, ODRL policy, message checks; ports as
Data Plane Signaling messages and states; its
Reads settings and chooses the adapter behind
Checks the caller's token, queries and
verifies its credentials and their status;
Sends saved DSP messages until delivered (ADR
DatasetStore and more, over one SQLite file
The transfer's DataFlows port, spoken as Data
Plane Signaling to the data plane
resolver, API key, SQLite, serving, panic
ports; a run at start and every hour, one
SHACL Core subset: loads shapes and code
lists, turns JSON-LD into RDF with local
authority's DID, keeps it on disk
(BundleStore), never goes back, and swaps the
rules in BundleCopy without a restart
Sends a started push transfer's data as one
POST to the consumer's endpoint, with the
push token (only its SHA-256 is kept), streams
the body into the push bucket
Suspend and terminate cut every running
download and push of a flow; the consumer's
membership is checked again on every use
Reads s3:// sources (GET) and stores received
One INFO log line, data transfer done, for
each pull, push sent and push received: flow,

C4 model, level 3. Light blue: components. Domain crates have no I/O; CI checks it with cargo tree. Without a bundle there are no SHACL checks. Gaia-X compliance services: PORTITOR_GAIAX_COMPLIANCE_ISSUERS.
The data plane, the push sender and the receiving route each write the audit line. Object storage: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 and PORTITOR_PUSH_BUCKET (ADR 0027).
